description: Investment calculator with an interactive chart. Works out what regular deposits could grow to at a long-run market average or a yearly rate you choose. Use it for monthly investment plans and questions like what $10 a day or $500 a month could become in 20 or 30 years. Single stocks cannot be run forward. People ask for it as "investment calculator", "investment growth calculator" or "how much should i invest each month".

amount.description: Dollars put in each time, above 0.

asset.description: A long-run rate to use. Give this or custom_annual_percent, not both.

cadence.description: How often the amount goes in.

custom_annual_percent.description: Your own yearly return in percent, so 7 means 7%. Give this or asset, not both.

name: plan_recurring_investment
title: Investment Calculator
